item.title: Mama no Sakuranbo Gari♪
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Silver Bullet Co., Ltd.
  • 発売日: 2012-03-23
  • スコア: 5.83/10 (50 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ママのさくらんぼ狩り♪
  • 英語名: Mama no Sakuranbo Gari♪

别名

  • Mamas Cherry Hunting

あらすじ

Ayumi is a housewife like any other, save for the fact that her husband doesn’t satisfy her needs.

One day, her friend Reika invites her to join a “cherry hunting” community, created to seek out young men and take their virginities.

Despite not being fond of the idea at first, she succumbs to the pleasure of having sex and being treated like a woman again, not to mention her maternal instinct waking up once more.

item.title: Mama no Kouen Debut
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Silver Bullet Co., Ltd.
  • 発売日: 2011-05-13
  • スコア: 6.12/10 (31 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ママの公園デビュー
  • 英語名: Mama no Kouen Debut

あらすじ

With her 3 year old daughter’s debut at the public playground, Yukiko became acquaintances with the neighborhood’s other housewives and is lured by them into a sea of pleasures.

Even though she is married, Yukiko’s initial guilt of sleeping with other men is before long turned into sessions where she finds herself happily shaking her hips on her own… This is a decadent story as seen through the heroine Yukiko’s point-of-view!

  • 英語名: Hoshi ni Negai o…

别名

  • 彗星（ほし）に願いを…

あらすじ

Kousuke is an ordinary uni student, living in the country. It is announced that a comet will come close to the Earth this summer. He is not interested in it, but his life changes a little. He is given an old radio from his neighbor. The radio airs a radio drama every night. “This story is about an ordinary uni student, living in the country, and his experience of one summer.” Since then, the things aired on radio last night happen to him on the next day. His a little bit strange summer experience starts now…
